- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Provided a basic ramen broth recipe with the following ingredients: 4 cups chicken or pork bones (or a combination), 2 cups water, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons sake (optional), 2 tablespoons mirin, 1 onion (sliced), 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1 piece ginger (sliced), scallions (for garnish).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for the ramen broth recipe include roasting bones, combining ingredients, simmering, and straining the broth.
- [PREFERENCE] User is interested in trying Tonkotsu Ramen and loves the idea of a rich, creamy pork bone broth.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips to make the Tonkotsu broth richer and creamier: longer simmering time (12-24 hours), using a variety of pork bones, roasting bones, using aromatics, adding umami (kombu or shiitake), straining and clarifying, and adding richness with fat.
